originals.ko: 너희는 가기 전에 그걸 할 필요가 있어.
originals.why: Natural colloquial North Welsh. It uses dach chi angen + verbnoun in the sense this LEGO teaches; the source English is a statement, so the Korean is a statement too.

topups.why: BUILD needs only 2. Also, '가야 해' could equally prompt 'rhaid i chi fynd'.
BUILD needs only 2. B01 and B02 are the cleaner open-ended builds.

topups.ko: 너희 그것에 대해 생각할 필요가 있어?

topups.why: The '~해야 해' wording could also prompt 'rhaid i chi'. Five stronger USE rows were already kept.
'머물러야 해' clashes with 'rhaid'. It also glosses aros differently from the 기다리다 sense, so the learner could hesitate.
